correctness.rationale: The theorem follows from four exact differential identities. Forward completeness is obtained by a Gronwall bound; the d<0 escape and d=0 convergence arguments use monotonicity and integrability; the d>0 trajectory and invariant-measure identities follow by averaging exact generator balances. Symbolic verification gives zero residual for every algebraic identity used.

originality.rationale: Prior Burke-Shaw work located includes temporal-asymptote studies, fractional-system surveys, and a mechanical torque decomposition. No located source states the combined forcing-sign trichotomy or the exact universal bounded-orbit/invariant-measure averages. Two uninspected full texts are recorded as explicit residual risks in REVIEW.md.

value.rationale: The result gives a sharp qualitative boundary at d=0 and exact parameter-level diagnostics for every bounded recurrent regime at d>0, including periodic and chaotic invariant measures, without assuming existence or structure of a particular attractor.
